title: references
description: The `references` key of `.ai/agentic.config.json`: the repositories an agent reads to see how a problem was solved before, each brought to its ref under `references/<dir>` by the Sync. Only the committed file is read; the local layer adds no References. Every `dir` is unique in the list, which this schema cannot say and the Sync refuses. A key the Sync refuses syncs nothing.

dir.description: The one directory under `references/` the clone lives in: letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-`, not starting with `.` or `-`.

repository.description: A URL `git` can fetch. A `https://github.com/` one fetches with the GitHub CLI's credentials. No whitespace, and no leading `-`, which `git` would read as an option.

ref.description: A branch, whose head the clone moves to, or a tag. `{name}` in it stands for the exact version the root `package.json` pins for package `name`, read through the default catalog of `pnpm-workspace.yaml` when the pin says `catalog:` or `catalog:default`. No whitespace, and no leading `-`.

skip.description: Paths the sparse checkout leaves out, relative to the clone and inside it. Empty or absent, the whole tree is checked out.

when.description: When an agent reaches for it.
